For Design/Management posts: Ph.D. with First Class at Bachelor's or Master's level, minimum 10 years' experience (at least 3 years as Associate Professor), and 6–10 research publications as applicable. | Important: Each of the 89 posts carries its own detailed essential-qualification and specialisation table (allied/relevant subject areas, alternate eligibility routes, and desirable qualifications) running across the full notification. how_to_apply: Visit the official University recruitment portal (linked on aud.delhi.gov.in).
Fill the application form mandatorily in online mode within the prescribed time limit indicated in the advertisement.
Pay the applicable fee online through credit/debit card, net banking or the payment gateway provided; apply and pay separately for each discipline if applying to more than one.
If applying for more than one reservation category for the same post/discipline, select the multiple categories before final submission and pay the applicable additional fee.
After successful online submission and payment, take a printout of the online application.
Compile the printed application with self-attested copies of all required documents, appropriately indexed and paginated in the order of the essential eligibility criteria.

Send the hard copy (preferably by Registered/Speed Post) to: Deputy Registrar (Recruitment & Promotion Cell), Room No. 31A, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Lothian Road, Kashmere Gate Campus, Delhi – 110006, clearly mentioning the post/discipline name on top of the envelope.

content_sections.text: All posts carry UGC pay scales plus admissible allowances, as per University/UGC/Government of India/Government of NCT of Delhi norms.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Note: Payment is accepted online only, via credit/debit card, net banking or the payment gateway provided on the University portal. Candidates applying for more than one discipline/post must apply and pay fees separately for each.

content_sections.heading: AUD Delhi Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Scrutiny/Screening Committee reviews all applications and prepares a list of eligible and not-eligible candidates based on stipulated criteria. The eligible/not-eligible lists (with reasons) are published on the University website; not-eligible candidates may submit grievances with documentary evidence within a stipulated deadline. For Assistant Professor posts, shortlisting for interview uses an Academic Score matrix (Table 3A of UGC 2018 Regulations) covering Graduation, Post-Graduation, M.Phil., Ph.D., NET/SLET/SET, research publications, teaching/post-doctoral experience and awards - maximum 100 marks. This score is used only for shortlisting; final selection is based on interview performance. For Professor and Associate Professor posts, shortlisting is based on academic records, publications, experience and Research Score as decided by the University. Selection may involve a presentation/seminar/interview or a combination, as required. Candidates residing outside India may be interviewed via video conferencing on prior request. Mere fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview; the University may restrict the number of candidates interviewed based on higher qualifications/experience where applications are numerous.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AUD Delhi Teaching Posts 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Applications with non-compliant indexing/pagination, or hard copies received after the due date, will not be taken up for screening and will be treated as rejected without assigning any reason. The University is not responsible for postal delays.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Bachelor's, Master's, M.Phil., Ph.D., B.Ed., as applicable) NET/SLET/SET certificate, or Ph.D. compliance certificate as per Annexure-I or Annexure-II (issued by the Registrar/Dean Academic Affairs) Equivalence Certificate from the Association of Indian Universities, New Delhi (mandatory for Ph.D. from a foreign university) Proof of research publications, project sanction/completion/utilisation certificates, patent filings, and Ph.D./M.Phil. supervision/award letters, as applicable Category certificate for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer, valid for FY 2026-27)/EWS/PwBD, in the format prescribed by the Government of India/Government of NCT of Delhi No Objection Certificate, for applicants already serving in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies Experience certificates (teaching/research/industry, as relevant to the post)

faq.question: Q1. How many teaching posts has AUD Delhi advertised?
faq.answer: AUD has advertised 89 posts - 24 Professor, 28 Associate Professor and 37 Assistant Professor - across 14 Schools, under Advertisement No. AUD/55-1(67)/Rect./2026/838 dated 31.07.2026.

faq.question: Q2. Is NET mandatory for Assistant Professor posts at AUD?
faq.answer: Candidates need NET/SLET/SET, or a Ph.D. meeting the specified UGC 2009/2016 exemption conditions, or a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the global top 500 (QS/THE/ARWU).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for AUD Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: ₹1,000 (non-refundable) for UR/OBC/EWS candidates; no fee for SC, ST, PwD and Women candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written exam for AUD Delhi teaching posts?
faq.answer: No. Selection is through screening/shortlisting of applications followed by an interview (and, where required, a presentation/seminar); there is no written examination.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay level for Assistant Professor at AUD?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor posts carry Academic Pay Level-10 (₹57,700–₹92,500), Associate Professor Level-13A (₹1,31,400–₹2,10,800), and Professor Level-14 (₹1,44,200–₹2,18,200).

faq.question: Q6. Can a candidate apply for more than one discipline?
faq.answer: Yes, but each discipline requires a separate application and separate fee payment.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: To the Deputy Registrar (Recruitment & Promotion Cell), Room No. 31A, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Lothian Road, Kashmere Gate Campus, Delhi – 110006, with the post/discipline name mentioned on the envelope.
